title: OpenClaw for Marketing and Content Teams: 6 Workflows That Run 24/7
summary: OpenClaw for marketing content teams: 6 automation workflows for research, drafting, and publishing. Content agents running 24/7 — not just when your laptop is on.
body_markdown: Zapier connects pre-built triggers to pre-built actions. OpenClaw can reason about content. Zapier can "when a new RSS item appears, send it to Slack." OpenClaw can "when a new competitor article appears, read it, identify the key argument and gaps, and send an editorial commentary to Slack." The reasoning layer is what makes content-specific automation genuinely useful rather than just mechanical data transfer.[Blink Claw](https://blink.new/claw) hosts OpenClaw 24/7 so the reasoning runs continuously, not just when your team is at their desks.
